headings: Baby & Paediatric Osteopathy in Sutton Coldfield
Cranial Osteopathy for Babies in Sutton Coldfield & Birmingham
What happens at the first appointment

match: As children grow, we also see aches
paras: At Exhale Osteopathy – Sutton Coldfield, Birmingham we treat babies and toddlers of all ages.

Cranial Osteopathy represents a delicate form of osteopathic treatment, employing extremely gentle manipulative techniques to facilitate the release of tension throughout the body, including the cranial region.

It is used commonly in the treatment of babies and children, but it can be an effective approach for people of all ages. It is a gentle yet extremely effective approach and may be used in a wide range of conditions for people of all ages, from birth to old age.

This may include back and neck pain, joint pain, digestive issues, sinus problems and headaches. In babies and children it can be helpful in problems of crying, reflux/digestive issues, sleeping and feeding difficulties.
Common conditions people seek Osteopathic care for babies and toddlers:

• Wind & Reflux Symptoms
  • Inability to turn head or neck
  • Improve latch and feeding
  • Breastfeeding difficulties
  • Soothe and relax your baby/infant
  • Crying & Irritability
  • Flat or odd shaped head

match: We take a detailed history, including pregnancy and birth
paras: At Exhale Osteopathy, Birmingham, we understand how precious your baby is. When you bring your baby in for cranial osteopathy, we begin by gathering essential details about your pregnancy, labour, and your baby’s development so far. This discussion helps us better understand any specific concerns you may have about your little one.

Following this, our experienced osteopath will perform a gentle assessment of your baby’s posture, joint mobility, muscle tone, and reflexes. This thorough examination ensures we provide care tailored to your baby’s unique needs.

Cranial osteopathy for babies involves delicate, soothing techniques such as gentle massage, stretching and cranial mobilisations. These methods are designed to help relax your baby, release tension, and support natural development. Parents often notice improvements in their baby’s feeding, sleeping, and overall comfort after treatment.

If you’re looking for trusted cranial osteopathy for babies in Birmingham, contact Exhale Osteopathy to book an appointment. We’re here to support your baby’s health and well-being with gentle, expert osteopathic care.

Many patients find it deeply relaxing
paras: Cranial osteopathy is a gentle and non-manipulative form of osteopathic treatment. This technique focuses on the cranial (head) and sacral (tailbone) regions to alleviate stress and tension throughout the body. It is particularly well-suited for adults who are sensitive to manipulation and holds significant benefits for babies and young children.
Cranial osteopathy can be applied as a standalone treatment or in conjunction with structural techniques, working synergistically to optimise the healing process.
